title: Firebox Dynamo
pages: The Firebox Dynamo is this mod's own Forge Energy (FE) generator. Craft it on a crafting table: three iron ingots (forge:ingots/iron) on top, Tin Wire, a Furnace and Tin Wire in the middle, and copper ingot, redstone dust (forge:dusts/redstone), copper ingot on the bottom row. It is mined with a stone pickaxe or better and drops its fuel and residue when broken.

Use: load fuel by right-clicking the dynamo with it; only items with a combustion recipe are accepted. Each recipe burns a whole batch at once and sets the output: 4 coal give 6,400 ticks at 20 FE/t (128,000 FE) and leave 1 Temper Ash, a lava bucket gives 20,000 ticks at 20 FE/t and returns its empty bucket, a blaze rod runs hot at 32 FE/t and crumbles to blaze powder. Wood burns at 12-16 FE/t into charcoal or fine ash (light gray dye), wool into gray dye, saplings, bamboo and kelp blocks into bone meal. Metal and minerals survive the fire: crossbows, smithing tables and tripwire hooks leave iron nuggets, note blocks redstone, daylight detectors quartz.

Condition: a fuel is only lit when its first tick fits the 32,000 FE buffer and its residue fits the residue slot (same item, under a full stack), so no fuel or residue is ever lost; empty the residue to keep it running. The grate glows and the dynamo gives light while burning. Right-click with an empty hand to read the buffer, burn time and current FE/t and to take out residue. The buffer, burn, rate and both slots are saved with the world. The dynamo only gives energy: no cable, machine or other generator can charge it.

Automation: hoppers and item pipes insert fuel through any face into the fuel slot; extraction from any face (a hopper below) only removes residue, never unburnt fuel. Every tick the dynamo pushes up to 32 FE into adjacent Trickle-class (Tier 0-1) machines, and any cable touching it pulls from its buffer (see Power Cables). Its power is Trickle class (16 V): it feeds Tin Wire directly, and touching a higher-class cable gives nothing. To collect several dynamos into a 64 V Copper Cable line, run their Tin Wire into a Trickle-Low Transformer set to Step up.

Recipes are datapack JSON under data/<namespace>/recipes/combustion. Type: arcana_industry:combustion. Fields: ingredient (item or tag), count (default 1), residue (item/count, required), burn_time (1-72000 ticks), energy_per_tick (1-64), priority (default 0). Highest priority wins; equal priorities use ascending recipe ID. With Just Enough Items installed, the Combustion category lists every fuel with its FE/t, total FE and residue, and the dynamo is its catalyst. JEI is optional.
